def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    tpls=[c for c in cs if len(c)>1]; seeds=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    # template info: set of colors with counts
    tmpl={}
    for cells in tpls:
        cc=Counter(g[a[0]][a[1]] for a in cells)
        # marker = colors appearing exactly once
        markers={col:a for col,a in cc.items() if cc[col]==1}
        tmpl[tuple(sorted(cells))]=markers
    # seed->template assignment: marker color == seed color
    used_templates=set()
    for s in seeds:
        sc=g[s[0]][s[1]]
        best=None
        for k2,mk in tmpl.items():
            if sc in mk:
                cnt=sum(1 for kk in tmpl if sc in tmpl[kk]); best=max(best,cnt) if False else None
        # pick template containing this color; prefer... take first (all demos have unique)
        cand=[k2 for k2,mk in tmpl.items() if sc in mk]
        assert len(cand)==1, (s,cand)
        k2=cand[0]
        mk=tmpl[k2]
        # anchor within template: the cell whose color == sc
        anc=[a for a in k2 if g[a[0]][a[1]]==sc][0]
        off=(s[0]-anc[0],s[1]-anc[1])
        for a in k2:
            rr,cc=a[0]+off[0],a[1]+off[1]
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==bg: res[rr][cc]=g[a[0]][a[1]]
    return res
for n in range(1,6):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    print(n, f(inp)==out)

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    tpls=[c for c in cs if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cells in tpls:
        tplcolors=collections.Counter(g[a[0]][a[1]] for a in cells)
        # anchor candidates: colors in template that occur as isolated singletons elsewhere
        anch={col for col in tplcolors if col!=bg and any(g[s[0]][s[1]]==col for s in singles)}
        if not anch: continue
        for s in singles:
            sc=g[s[0]][s[1]]
            if sc not in anch: continue
            anc=[a for a in cells if g[a[0]][a[1]]==sc][0]
            off=(s[0]-anc[0],s[1]-anc[1])
            for a in cells:
                rr,cc=a[0]+off[0],a[1]+off[1]
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and g[rr][cc]==bg: res[rr][cc]=g[a[0]][a[1]]
    return res

def f(g):
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    bg=Counter(x for r in g for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(g,bg)
    tpls=[list(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    res=[r[:] for r in g]
    for cells in tpls:
        cc=collections.Counter(g[a[0]][a[1]] for a in cells)
        cand=[col for col,cn in cc.items() if col!=bg]
        # anchor candidates: colors appearing exactly once in template AND as singletons elsewhere; else minority color
        anc_cands=[]
        for col in cand:
            cnt_in_tpl=cc[col]
            nseeds=sum(1 for s in singles if g[s[0]][s[1]]==col)
            if cnt_in_tpl==1 or nseeds: anc_cands.append((col,cnt_in_tpl,nseeds))
        if not anc_cands: continue
        anc_cands.sort(key=lambda t:-t[2])
        for s in singles:
            sc=g[s[0]][s[1]]
            if sc not in [a[0] for a in anc_cands]: continue
            # pick candidate with max nseeds / match
            mk=max(anc_cands,key=lambda t:t[2])[0]
            anc=[a for a in cells if g[a[0]][a[1]]==mk][0]
            off=(s[0]-anc[0],s[1]-anc[1])
            for a in cells:
                rr,cc_=a[0]+off[0],a[1]+off[1]
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc_<w and g[rr][cc_]==bg: res[rr][cc_]=g[a[0]][a[1]]
    return res
for n in range(1,8):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    p=f(inp); print(n,p==out)
    if p!=out:
        mis=[(i,j,out[i][j],p[i][j]) for i in range(len(inp)) for j in range(len(inp[0])) if p[i][j]!=out[i][j]]
        print('  count',len(mis),mis[:6])

def transforms(off):
    o=[tuple(x) for x in off]
    H=[(y,-x) for x,y in o]
    V=[(-y,x) for x,y in o]
    R=[(y,x) for x,y in [(b,a) for a,b in o]]  # transpose
    RH=[(-y,-x) for x,y in o]
    RV=[(y,x) for x,y in [(b,a) for a,b in o]]
    return [o,H,V,R,RH,RV]
def analyze(n,mname='id'):
    inp,out=G[f'Demo pair {n} input'],G[f'Demo pair {n} output']
    bg=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    cs=comps(inp,bg)
    tpls=[list(c) for c in cs if len(c)>1]; singles=[c[0] for c in cs if len(c)==1]
    res=True
    for cells in tpls:
        cc=collections.Counter(inp[a[0]][a[1]] for a in cells)
        anch=[col for col in cc if sum(1 for s in singles if inp[s[0]][s[1]]==col)>0]
        mk=max(anch,key=lambda c:sum(1 for s in singles if inp[s[0]][s[1]]==c))
        anc=[a for a in cells if inp[a[0]][a[1]]==mk][0]
        offs=[(a[0]-anc[0],a[1]-anc[1]) for a in cells]
        for s in singles:
            if inp[s[0]][s[1]]!=mk: continue
            for m in transforms(offs):
                good=True
                for dr,dc in m:
                    rr,cc_=s[0]+dr,s[1]+dc
                    if not(0<=rr<len(inp) and 0<=cc_<len(inp[0])) or inp[rr][cc_]!=bg: good=False;break
                if good: print(n,mname,'transform ok for seed',s[:2]); break
            else: continue
            break
        else: print(n,'no transform fit')
for n in range(1,8):
    print('=== demo',n)
    analyze(n,'id')
    analyze(n,'flipH')
    analyze(n,'flipV')

def corr(inp,out,tpl_off,col):
    """template = single cell (r0,c0,color col) + offsets tpl_off; find best shift"""
    h,w=len(inp),len(inp[0])
    # background = most common
    bgc=Counter(x for r in inp for x in r).most_common(1)[0][0]
    best=[]
    for dr in range(-h,h):
        for dc in range(-w,w):
            score=0; n=0
            for (r0,c0) in [(0,0)]+[(drr,dcc) for drr,dcc in tpl_off]:
                rr,cc=r0+dr+drr,c0+dc+dcc
                if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w:
                    n+=1
                    if inp[rr][cc]==bgc: score+=(out[rr][cc]==col)
                    elif out[rr][cc]!=col: score-=10
            best.append((score,n,dr,dc))
    best.sort(reverse=True)
    return best[:5]
